P. 1</ls>. .²3 To mind, take care of, look to; तातस्त्वां चिन्तयिष्यति <ls>Ś. 4</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> also <ls>R. 1. 64</ls>; <ls>U. 1. 19</ls>. .²4 To call to mind, remember. .²5 To find out, devise, discover, think out; कोऽप्युपायश्चिन्त्यताम् <ls>H. 1</ls>. .²6 To regard as, esteem. .²7 To weigh, discriminate. .²8 To discuss, treat of, consider.
